reasons: The set successfully distributes distinct functional roles: Image 1 provides a crop-identity overview showing mature alfalfa, Image 2 offers agronomic close evidence of row spacing and vegetation, and Image 3 presents the irrigation-system story with a pre-installation view of young plants and farm infrastructure.
The presence of the identical AFP product across all three images is expected and does not constitute duplication of editorial roles.

Visual variety is maintained through different cropping stages, camera angles, and background contexts (field vs. farm buildings) without any hard reject factors like contradictory crops or prohibited people.
